market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil above $101 and trade war escalation drive risk-off. Dow -500 pts signals broad selloff. Yields rising, dollar weakening. Expect continued equity pressure until Middle East de-escalates or oil stabilizes. Consumer and rate-sensitive sectors most vulnerable. 1-3 month range: S&P 500 likely tests lower support; energy and gold outperform.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if geopolitical shocks resolve. AI capex cycle, copper-driven electrification, and M&A consolidation support structural growth. However, persistent inflation from energy and trade barriers could delay rate cuts, pressuring valuations. 6-12 month: rotation from growth to value/energy; Canadian equities face headwinds unless trade war de-escalates.
